raw_market.question: 4Q Spread: Steelers (-6.5)
raw_market.description:
In the fourth quarter of the NFL game between Colts and Steelers, scheduled for October 11 at 1:00 PM ET:

This market will resolve to "Steelers" if the Steelers outscore the Colts by 7 or more points in the fourth quarter.

Otherwise, this market will resolve to "Colts".

Only points scored during that period count; overtime is not included.

If the game is postponed, this market will remain open until the game has been completed. If the game is canceled entirely, with no make-up game, this market will resolve 50-50.
